_provenance.covers: Per-node detection within one shared parent: a V3 `container` directly parenting both legacy-flat widgets and V4 atomic (`e-`) widgets as siblings
_provenance.capturedVia: Built by hand in Elementor's editor (human), captured via `wp post meta get 5 _elementor_data` (EMCP-008)
_provenance.setupNote: wp-v4-pro has both `container` and `e_atomic_elements` experiments active by default, but the editor's 'Add Section' always defaults to atomic e-flexbox while both are active. To get a classic V3 container here, e_atomic_elements/e_opt_in_v4/e_opt_in_v4_page were deactivated just long enough to add the container, then re-activated before adding the e-heading/e-paragraph widgets that ended up nested inside that same container (Elementor allowed this — atomic content widgets are not restricted to atomic layout parents).
